mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies at Harriet Park with a temperature of 65 degrees, though the air quality is moderate at 53. The moon is in a waxing gibbous phase. You can catch the ISS passing overhead at 4:59 AM, rising in the west near Mount Horeb and heading toward the northeast near Madison. Overnight, temperatures will drop to 48 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

In city news, the Verona Senior Center is inviting residents to order flexible, catered lunch options for dine-in or pick-up. Additionally, Phase 2 of the Mark Drive reconstruction project is ongoing with new gravel bases installed and asphalt work expected by mid-November.

There is plenty to do in Verona. Today, enjoy yoga at Insight Wellness, pizza at Lake Lou-ee, or trivia at The Bogey Factory. Tomorrow, ART House 360 hosts various performances, and Hop Haus holds trivia at 6:30 PM. Looking further ahead, Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee have live music throughout the week.
In our weekly police report, officers arrested a school bus driver for O W I on October 15 after receiving reports of dangerous driving behavior near Whalen Road and Fairview Terrace.
Enjoy the featured flavor of the day, Chocolate Covered Strawberry. The store is currently open and will be serving guests until 10:00 PM tonight.
